summary.text: One of the allied captains whom Hector heartened when the Trojans fought over Patroclus' body — named only in the rally of Book 17 among the tribes round about Troy.

story.text: When the struggle raged about the fallen son of Menoetius, Hector went to and fro in the flashing armour of Achilles and heartened Chroraius among the captains of the allies — beside Mesthles, Glaucus, Medon, Thersilochus, Asteropaeus, Deisenor, Hippothous, Phorcys, and Ennomus the augur.
